descriptions.introduction: Get started with Hyvor Relay, an open-source email API for developers. Create a project, add a sending domain, and send your first email.
descriptions.domains: Add and verify sending domains in Hyvor Relay with a single DKIM TXT record. Learn about domain statuses and automating domains with the API.
descriptions.sendEmails: Send emails with the Hyvor Relay API. Request format, retries and idempotency, response status codes, rate limits, and email size limits.
descriptions.sendEmailsSmtp: Send emails through Hyvor Relay over SMTP. Compare SMTP with the API, set up SMTP credentials, and see how MIME messages map to API fields.
descriptions.simulator: Test bounces, complaints, deferrals, and custom SMTP responses with our SMTP simulator, without sending emails to real people.
descriptions.consoleApi: Hyvor Relay Console API reference: authentication, scopes, rate limits, errors, and endpoints for sends, domains, webhooks, API keys, and more.
descriptions.webhooks: Receive Hyvor Relay webhooks when emails are accepted, deferred, bounced, or complained about, and when domains or suppressions change.
